name: Cross-market transfer: dollar-weakness-gated crypto momentum
rationale: The dollar is the canonical cross-market transfer channel into crypto: a weak dollar loosens global financial conditions and is a tailwind for risk assets, so crypto momentum should pay better when EUR/USD is high (dollar weak) than when the dollar is bid. This rides medium-term crypto momentum ONLY while the dollar is on the weak side of a fitted level, and stands aside when the dollar strengthens (a risk-off cross-asset deleveraging tell). EUR/USD is a tier0 point-in-time daily close (next-day availability floor, NO look-ahead). Disconfirmer: the position is closed when EUR/USD crosses back down through the exit level (dollar re-strengthening). The signal must earn its place through the deterministic Gate (deflated Sharpe / PBO / holdout / FDR) — a cross-market regime that does not survive cost + multiple-testing is a STOP, not a win.
catalyst: positive crypto momentum while the dollar is weak (risk-on cross-market regime)
